name: PDS P-004/P-005: the physical scenario phases A-D pass end to end against the same-box two-instance rig through the physical-rig entry point, bracketed by the verification harness, with every producer exiting and every remote read converging (live, run 14, 2026-09-30)

codeUnderTest.driftSinceRun: Checked 12:33Z: papercusp-desktop c5d44568..HEAD touches only bin/dev-operator-ifneeded.sh and bin/lib/federation-asserts.selftest.sh; no bound source path changed.

summary: Same-box rehearsal run 14. `.papercusp/scratch/r15-drill14.sh` pinned the papercusp-desktop gitlink c5d44568 (superproject de2870099d) at 11:20:37Z and brought the same-box rig up: tower owner :18471, VM owner :18571, a testnet DHT, pot hello-world-pot, repo key gh-1296269. Rig-up exited 0 at 11:28:12Z after the VM answered, the tower held both device namespaces and every member head was in canonical staging. The drill then ran `hive-git-drill.sh --rig same-box --only-phase` for phases A,B,C,D. That goes through the same chain as the physical rig: hive-git-drill.sh -> hive-git-physical-probe.sh -> hive-git-physical-scenario.sh, with rig-profile.sh retargeting the host variables. The verification harness bracketed the run (run 20260930T112812Z-1916007): the physical phase passed in 819812 ms (11:28:13Z-11:41:53Z), and the drill printed one HARNESS_RESULT line with verdict=pass and first_failure=none. DRILL-EXIT=0 at 11:41:54Z. The rig came down cleanly (RIG-DOWN-EXIT=0 at 11:41:55Z).

assertions.criteria: The physical scenario runs against the same-box two-instance rig from the same entry point used for the physical rig.
assertions.observed: Log line `SAME_BOX_REHEARSAL phases=A,B,C,D rig=~/.papercusp-same-box-rigs/r15-20260930T112037Z`, then the scenario's own lines `hive-git-physical-scenario: PHASE_SKIP E..J (not selected)` and `PARTIAL_RUN phases=A,B,C,D passed 2026-09-30T11:28:54.310Z..2026-09-30T11:41:50.474Z`. Probe stdout `{"schemaVersion":"hive-git-physical-partial/v1","phases":"A,B,C,D","releaseEvidence":false}`. The scenario file was not forked: the same-box run executed papercusp-desktop/bin/vm-rig/hive-git-physical-scenario.sh through hive-git-physical-probe.sh.

assertions.criteria: Every drill run is bracketed by vh.sh, each phase declared through vh_phase/vh_begin, and one HARNESS_RESULT line names the first failing phase.
assertions.observed: `VH_RUN harness=hive-git-drill run=20260930T112812Z-1916007 plan=setup:skip,mode:skip,leg-a:skip,leg-b:skip,leg-c:skip,physical:run,leg-d:skip,leg-f:skip`, `VH_BEGIN phase=physical`, `VH_PHASE phase=physical status=passed`, and exactly one `HARNESS_RESULT harness=hive-git-drill verdict=pass run=20260930T112812Z-1916007 first_failure=none passed=1 failed=0 blocked=0 skipped=7 reused=0`. The harness wrote contract.json, plan.json, phases.jsonl and result.json.

assertions.criteria: Every ssh producer mode exits as soon as it has written its result.
assertions.observed: Phases A-D invoke the phase-a..d observe/drive producer modes and rig-preflight many times over ssh-equivalent calls; the physical phase completed in 13m40s with no stalled producer, and the drill exited 0 one second after the scenario's PARTIAL_RUN line (11:41:50Z -> 11:41:54Z). On the real physical VM, a standalone rig-preflight producer exited in 7.1 s wall time (docs/evidence/pds-p003-live-rig-preflight-six-checks-2026-09-30.json).

assertions.criteria: No drill step decides on a single read of remote state after an async action; no drill failure is a transient read.
assertions.observed: Phases A-D decided every post-action remote observation through converging waits and passed. Across the same-box window (runs 8-14), the attempt audit on WI-10003976 (posts 1151165 and 1151167) lists each failure fingerprint with its cause; none was a read that a re-read of the same remote state would have passed.

falsifier: The physical scenario cannot run against the same-box rig, or runs through a different entry point; a drill run without exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line; a producer mode that stays running after writing its result; a drill failure whose immediate re-read of the same remote state passes.
command: bash .papercusp/scratch/r15-drill14.sh  (same-box-rig.sh up -> papercusp-desktop/bin/hive-git-drill.sh --rig same-box --only-phase A,B,C,D -> same-box-rig.sh down)
note: Same-box results are diagnostic for the drill's own release gate (D-005): they are never release evidence for P-301, and the drill says so itself (releaseEvidence:false). For AUTO-BAR-R-4-P-005 the same-box rig is exactly the plane the clause names. For the P-004 clauses this is a real two-instance execution of the shipped drill code; the physical-rig rig-preflight evidence covers the producer-exit property on the real VM. Unit guards bound separately: hive-git-drill-rehearsal.test.ts, hive-git-drill-single-read-guard.test.ts, physical-drill-producer.test.ts, hive-git-drill-phase-select.test.ts.
